failures.message: names nothing the suite ran at head — `ensure_mirror`'s fetch of an existing mirror neither prunes nor overwrites a ref under `refs/saffron/`. A task ref and a `refs/saffron/values/` ref the checkout lacks both survive, and a task ref the checkout holds at another commit keeps the mirror's commit. A branch the checkout deleted is still pruned, and a branch it gained is still fetched.
